items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Charlie Lewis will tell you that same thing because George played with him.

ctx.x: How was he compared with, say, Punch or Buddy Petit and some of the other fellas?

Well, Chris was, Chris was a real, he was good. He was strong. But I'll tell you one thing. There was nobody, there was nobody to play a blues like Chris. He was a blues man. You couldn't get him to beat him playing the blues. Charlie Lewis will tell you that same thing because George played with him.
You mean all the variations and the things he'd do?
